searchText: Question about lobby and "TryContributeError::AnotherContributionInProgress". The idea is to retry until sequencer allows you to participate? Or is lobby a form of managed queue? <CarlBeek> the lobby is not a queue, you are correct that you need to keep trying & pinging Trying to use chotto (java client) and erlang client I'm writing. Both get AnotherContributionInProgress answer from https://kzg-ceremony-sequencer-dev.fly.dev/. All while lobby size is 0 or 1. Is sequencer stuck by any chance? I'm testing it now via the website and it is currently saying that there is another contribution in progress <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> i have this too (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <Kev> [reply]: I'm testing it now via the website and it is currently saying that there is another contribution in progress) <@334704997122179072> or <@456226577798135808> do you have access to the logs? <@550420431744794624> <https://github.com/zkparty/trusted-setup-frontend/pull/64> Just updated the FAQ PR using the tags that will enable it to work with translations. Here is the PR <https://github.com/zkparty/trusted-setup-frontend/pull/74> Also <@992497067878518875>, getting errors related to `node-polyfill-webpack-plugin` when loading up the `main` branch, looks like this may be related to some recent changes? Yes! <@293496799854067712> told me about it. It is related to a new webpack configuration I setup for the wallet providers. Could you try deleting the `node_modules` and running `npm install` again? Just tested that but it didn't work 🤔 Fix it 😊 ! (sorry I am working with Windows/WSL and didn't catch that bug). Could you pull a new change from main and try again? <@293496799854067712> <@397809066115727383> That worked!
